prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measurements across almost all tests.
adoption, new_flow changes produced a confirmed winning test, though subsequent tests showed no clear effect.
choose_path, redesign changes consistently degraded performance across multiple tests.
finish, new_screen, finish, hint, choose_path, copy, home, wait_info, and home, notification changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
finish, redesign and sign_in, reorder changes produced no positive effects across multiple tests, with some hurting performance.
Evidence remains thin for all single-test change types, including sign_in, layout and home, new_flow.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Photo Multi Upload Assistant Flow: Introduces an interactive multi-photo validation sub-flow on the upload screen that guides users to select compatible photos before generation. (why: Support emails mention failures and visual errors during custom pet creation; assisting user upload quality reduces drop-off during adoption.)
1: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Split Progress Redesign: Redesigns the waiting screen into a split view with live status steps, estimated time, and tip indicators. (why: The home stage takes a long median time (201s, mean 2336s). Redesigning the waiting view keeps users engaged during load.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Name Confirmation Screen: Adds a new pet naming step between friend selection and adoption certificate to personalize the pet companion before finalizing setup. (why: Adoption stage conversion drops to 63.3%. A dedicated naming screen increases emotional attachment before final certificate generation.)
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Control Quick Interactive Tutorial Flow: Adds interactive quick-action demonstration cards to the home intro screen detailing hotkeys and visibility controls. (why: Support received multiple tickets regarding post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets on desktop.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Verification Hint: Displays an explicit notification hint on the sign-in screen informing users that authenticating preserves pet save data across devices. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in. Clear messaging upfront improves account linking confidence.)
5: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Category Grid Layout: Updates the pick_friend screen layout to a structured grid with step counter enabled. (why: Adoption has a 63.3% conversion rate and median duration of 89s. Grid layout streamlines visual companion choices.)
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Launch Readiness Progress Tracker: Displays clear stage progress status updates while loading pet assets on the waiting screen. (why: High average waiting time (mean 2336s) causes user uncertainty. Granular stage updates reassure users the app has not stalled.)
7: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Spotlight Redesign: Redesigns home_intro into a spotlight layout highlighting key companion features and immediate launch action. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8%. A clean spotlight focal layout helps finalize setup smoothly.)
